anchor.quote: Let $W$ denote the number of roles, that is, the number of fixed wire places in the network.
let $R$ denote the padded row count
row index $i$, its position among the rows that share that prefix, counted from 0.
Let $V$ denote the node volume after padding

anchor.note: Modular arithmetic (integers modulo m, residue classes) is a known concept covered by the discrete mathematics background in the reader profile, so $i \bmod W$ is the remainder of i divided by W.

gaps.quote: Every role stream also covers the same local address set.
gaps.note: The page never says what a local address set is, and the claim that every role stream covers the same one is presented as a cited fact with no statement of what the source establishes or why it applies here. The reader cannot check it from the page, and the conclusion that each role stream holds V/W bits depends on it.
